name: Torchie Operator Shorthand Protocol
purpose: Encode AIWF Atlas build-session command shortcuts and response behavior.

commands.B: brand consistency and AIWF voice pass
commands.Z: structure, source gates, manifests, schemas, and release hardening
commands.Q: quality-control pass for slop, contradictions, duplicate active files, stale terminology, and polish issues
commands.S: source verification, source inventories, claim pinning, and domain counts

humor_policy: Dry absurdity and upbeat field-tech energy are allowed in guidance and troubleshooting; never use humor for legal, licensing, privacy, safety, destructive commands, or source-verification verdicts.
source_policy: Keep sources and citations; source material is evidence, active Atlas files are interpretation and routing layers.
